summary: Life On The ISS!How do astronauts live in space? It is so funny!First, Eat. In space, food floats! No plates! You have to catch your food. Even water floats!Second, Sleep. Astronauts sleep in a sleeping bag on the wall! If not, they will float away!Third, Work. They do experiments every day. And guess what? They see 16 sunrises a day! Because the ISS goes around Earth so fast!Life in space is fun, but Earth is still best! Because on Earth, we can eat satay, sleep on a bed, and hug our family!Thank you!
